title: ping
description:
Heartbeat (spec §6.1). Sent by the core every 10 seconds; the plugin must answer within 30 seconds or the core closes the socket and applies the restart policy.

Over AF_UNIX a dead process usually EOFs on its own, so this mostly catches the harder case: a process that is alive, holds the socket open, and has stopped making progress. A blocking read cannot tell that apart from an idle house.
